title: LIQUIDITY_POOL_DEPOSIT fails with LIQUIDITY_POOL_DEPOSIT_NOT_AUTHORIZED
pattern: A transaction whose LIQUIDITY_POOL_DEPOSIT operation fails at apply is still written into the closed ledger: its fee is charged, its sequence number is consumed, and nothing it did is kept. The result carries the operation's code (not_authorized). The ARQ trustline is only authorized to maintain liabilities: it keeps its pool shares but cannot add to them.

hazards.placement: deposit while only authorized to maintain liabilities
AUTHORIZED_TO_MAINTAIN_LIABILITIES keeps pool shares but cannot add to them

facts.says: No operation changed state: the operation meta is empty.
The fee is still charged: the fee source changes in fee processing.
